comment:
* VerityTreeBuilder is used to generate the root hash of verity tree built from the input file.
 * This version was adopted from VerityTreeBuilder.java in ApkSigner tool and changed to work on
 * all target APIs.

variables.name: CHUNK_SIZE
variables.comment: * Maximum size (in bytes) of each node of the tree.

variables.name: JCA_ALGORITHM
variables.comment: * Digest algorithm (JCA Digest algorithm name) used in the tree.

methods.name: static byte[] computeChunkVerityTreeAndDigest(@NonNull String apkPath) throws IOException, NoSuchAlgorithmException
private static byte[] getRootHashFromTree(MessageDigest md, ByteBuffer verityBuffer)
methods.comment: * Returns the digested root hash from the top level (only page) of a verity tree.

methods.name: private static ByteBuffer generateVerityTree(MessageDigest md, final RandomAccessFile file) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Returns the byte buffer that contains the whole verity tree.
     *
     * The tree is built bottom up. The bottom level has 256-bit digest for each 4 KB block in the
     * input file.  If the total size is larger than 4 KB, take this level as input and repeat the
     * same procedure, until the level is within 4 KB.  If salt is given, it will apply to each
     * digestion before the actual data.
     *
     * The returned root hash is calculated from the last level of 4 KB chunk, similarly with salt.
     *
     * The tree is currently stored only in memory and is never written out.  Nevertheless, it is
     * the actual verity tree format on disk, and is supposed to be re-generated on device.

methods.name: private static int[] calculateLevelOffset(long dataSize, int digestSize)
methods.comment:
* Returns an array of summed area table of level size in the verity tree.  In other words, the
     * returned array is offset of each level in the verity tree file format, plus an additional
     * offset of the next non-existing level (i.e. end of the last level + 1).  Thus the array size
     * is level + 1.

methods.name: private static void digestDataByChunks(MessageDigest md, long size, DataSource dataSource, ByteBuffer dataSink) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Digest data source by chunks then feeds them to the sink one by one.  If the last unit is
     * less than the chunk size and padding is desired, feed with extra padding 0 to fill up the
     * chunk before digesting.

methods.name: private static MessageDigest getNewMessageDigest() throws NoSuchAlgorithmException
methods.comment: * Obtains a new instance of the message digest algorithm.

methods.name: private static byte[] digest(MessageDigest md, ByteBuffer data)
methods.comment: Returns the digest of data with salt prepended.

methods.name: private static long divideRoundup(long dividend, long divisor)
methods.comment: Divides a number and round up to the closest integer.

methods.name: private static ByteBuffer slice(ByteBuffer buffer, int begin, int end)
methods.comment: Returns a slice of the buffer with shared the content.
